notes: Artifact written as an append-only tenth-pass source hunt. No snapshots or canonical evidence files were edited.

Accepted rows are limited to native post/repo URLs with visible metrics and direct company/founder/account attribution; profile pages, generic searches, weak quote-only context, and web-only context were rejected.
LinkedIn postedAt values use the first datePublished value exposed in the public page HTML for the post. Instagram timestamps are only included when visible in public search results.
GitHub metrics are from the public GitHub repository API; zero values are retained because they are visible native counters, not inferred metrics.
Official a16z/company pages were used only as attribution context and never as accepted evidence URLs.
